what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] The flush regression test asks `flush_review_batches` to prove committed `round-*` directory count, but that function only writes tally and findings batches. `flush_round_log_after_coder` owns round-dir log writes.
scenario_or_breakage: Following the plan literally can create a failing test or pull round-log writer setup into a body-validation fix. That expands the change beyond the scoped `write_tally_main` fix.
suggested_fix: Keep the `flush_review_batches` regression focused on second-flush tally overwrite and cumulative `review-findings-full.jsonl`. Drop the committed `round-*` assertion, or treat source `round-*` dirs as setup only.
